text:
olivia (AE): starting thread for FinOps Pilot — customer wants to rotate their BYOK material every 60 minutes during the trial. need ops feasibility + rough surcharge.
pete.finops (customer): correct. our compliance team requires that any data-encrypting key becomes invalid within 60 minutes. DEKs under a CMK is acceptable — we don't want full CMK re-creation each hour.
rahul (SE): ok. two technical paths: 1) per-request CMK ops (expensive + throttle risk) 2) DEK envelope encryption with hourly rewraps (preferred). which are you leaning to?
pete.finops (customer): DEK envelope is preferred. but we need proof during POC that no stale DEK decrypts after 60m. also want to understand latency impact.
maria (crypto-ops): doable but notes: - HSM/KMS APIs often have per-minute rate limits; frequent rewraps at high QPS can hit quotas. - our runtime uses KV caches for tokens/DEKs — we'll need a cache eviction webhook or TTL check.
olivia (AE): pete, expected QPS and concurrency for the POC?
pete.finops (customer): baseline 150 qps, demos spike to ~500 qps for ~10 minutes. most requests are <1s.
rahul (SE): with DEK approach only rotation events call CMK. strategy: create short-lived DEKs scoped to token buckets (e.g., 30s buckets), rotate DEKs hourly, and add a /admin/keys/invalidate endpoint to force runtime eviction. that keeps steady-state crypto cheap.
dan (finance): pricing provision: if rotation causes KMS usage to rise from ~2k ops/week to ~12k ops/week, we'd charge a temporary rotation premium. estimate $300-$900 for POC window depending on provider fees. need to confirm with billing.
maria (crypto-ops): operational checklist to send to customer: 1) allowlist IPs for KMS/HSM 2) service account + IAM roles 3) agreed maintenance window for any batched rewraps 4) acceptance tests.
rahul (SE): acceptance test plan (short): - ramp to spike QPS for N minutes - trigger rotation - attempt decrypt with old DEK and expect failure - run latency p95 check - watch KMS ThrottleCount metric. we'll supply a small CLI harness and a Postman collection.
pete.finops (customer): can you provide the CLI harness and a short runbook we can hand to our infra team? they'd like automated allowlist scripts if possible.
olivia (AE): yes, we'll provide. maria/rahul, can you produce a 1-page runbook + test harness + pricing blurb by EOD tomorrow? dan, can you sanity-check the surcharge?
dan (finance): will check. quick note: if they force per-request CMK ops (no envelope/dek), pricing model changes significantly — likely monthly minimum and higher per-op surcharge. flagging.
maria (crypto-ops): sample rotate/verify snippet for the POC: ```bash
# trigger POC rotation
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/admin/rotate?env=poc -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"
# verify last DEK is active and old fails
curl -sS https://api.redwood.example/v1/keys/verify?key=last | jq .result
```
rahul (SE): also will include recommended cache TTLs (default 50m for DEKs) and a 'grace' debounce to avoid simultaneous rewrap storms when many nodes rotate.
olivia (AE): legal-bot — any concerns adding a fallback to Redwood-managed keys if customer-managed HSM throttles? we want to include an opt-in in the SOW and liability language.
legal-bot: automated note: include explicit consent checkbox for fallback and limit on duration. recommend limiting fallback to non-production POC only and add a liability cap for key custody while in fallback.
pete.finops (customer): fallback ok if clearly called out in SOW and we can opt out. also need logs showing when fallback was used.
dan (finance): will include the fallback as an optional add-on fee and require notification before automatic failover.
maria (crypto-ops): last note: if they require sub-hour rotation (e.g., every 15m) or per-request CMK ops, we will need a capacity plan and likely dedicated HSM pool. escalate to sales-engineering and finance. :warning:
pete.finops (customer): we'll start with hourly DEK rotation and run the POC. thanks for quick turn. :thumbsup:
olivia (AE): great — milestone: runbook + CLI harness + SOW language + pricing blurb by EOD tomorrow. looping in legal and finance now.
